hypotheses.P0_semantic_features_explain_heldout_cha: Relation/rule features explain at least 30 percent of centered held-out margin-operator variation in every seed.
hypotheses.P1_address_features_beat_semantics: Entity/digit address features exceed semantic held-out R2 by at least 0.10 in every seed.
hypotheses.P2_short_additive_description_is_suffici: The combined bounded feature model explains at least 50 percent of held-out variation in every seed.
hypotheses.P3_feature_models_beat_permutation_null: Every seed's best real held-out R2 exceeds the 95th percentile of ten target-permutation nulls by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.P4_training_fit_transfers_to_new_pairs: For the combined model, held-out R2 is no more than 0.20 below validation R2 in every seed.
